title: Google Workspace Posture
description: Google Workspace identity and security posture artifact.

collected_at_level.description: Collection level the artifact was produced at. Audit and internal additions are strictly additive; the schema version stays 1.0.0 (the collector binary version carries the level-aware signal).

usage_report_date.description: Date of the Google Workspace usage report snapshot (typically yesterday).

org_domain.description: Primary domain of the Google Workspace tenant.

locked_pct.description: Percentage of users currently locked out.

inactive_pct.description: Percentage of active users inactive for 90+ days (from Directory API lastLoginTime).

inventory.description: Per-user inventory (audit and above). Each row carries primary_email, status, org_unit_path, 2sv flags, and activity flags; internal adds last_login_at. Per-user passkey / password strength are not available per user.

truncated_inventory.description: True when the per-user inventory was capped (50,000 rows, ACTIVE-first then email ascending). Omitted when within the cap.

truncated_inventory_dropped.description: Number of user inventory rows dropped by the cap. Omitted when within the cap.

active_7d_pct.description: Percentage of users who logged in within the last 7 days.

active_30d_pct.description: Percentage of users who logged in within the last 30 days.

2sv_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of users enrolled in 2-step verification.

2sv_enforced_pct.description: Percentage of users with 2-step verification enforced by policy.

2sv_protected_pct.description: Percentage of users actually protected by 2-step verification.

passkey_users_pct.description: Percentage of users with passkeys enrolled.

security_keys_total.description: Total number of registered security keys across the tenant.

privileged_users_count.description: Number of unique active privileged users across super admin and delegated admin roles.

privileged_users_2sv_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active privileged users enrolled in 2-step verification.

privileged_users_2sv_enforced_pct.description: Percentage of active privileged users with 2-step verification enforced.

inventory.description: Per-privileged-user inventory (audit and above): primary_email, super/delegated flags, 2sv flags, role names; internal adds the org_unit_scoped flag.

custom_roles.description: Admin-defined (non-system) custom roles (audit and above): name, description, privilege_count.

weak_password_pct.description: Percentage of users with weak passwords.

password_length_non_compliant_pct.description: Percentage of users with passwords that do not meet length requirements.

authorized_apps_count.description: Number of third-party apps authorized in the tenant.

lookback_days.description: Number of days of Context-Aware Access audit history searched for device-state deny events.

context_aware_access_denied_events.description: Total Context-Aware Access deny events observed in the lookback window.

device_state_denied_events.description: Count of deny events that included a device-state parameter, which is positive evidence that a device-state access level fired.

managed_device_requirement_evidenced.description: Whether Context-Aware Access audit logs show device-state-based access denials. This is deny-event evidence, not proof of complete policy coverage.

access_policy_name.description: Access Context Manager policy resource used for config enrichment.

access_policy_parent.description: Parent organization resource for the access policy.

basic_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic Access Context Manager access levels in the resolved policy.

custom_access_levels_count.description: Number of custom CEL-based access levels in the resolved policy. These are not deeply analyzed by the collector.

basic_device_policy_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic access levels that include a devicePolicy condition.

basic_managed_device_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic device-policy access levels that explicitly restrict allowed device management levels to managed devices.

basic_device_policy_access_level_titles.description: Titles of basic access levels that include a devicePolicy condition.

levels.description: Per-access-level rows (audit and above): title, custom flag, device-policy summary. Internal adds rule details (IP subnetworks, regions, required access levels, allowed device-management and encryption statuses).

groups.description: Groups surface (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: total / admin_created / user_created counts, external_members_allowed count, plus the per-group inventory (email, name, member_count, settings); truncated_inventory / truncated_inventory_dropped report the 10,000-group cap. Internal: per-group member lists (bounded by a 200k total-row cap; truncated_group_memberships flags that cap).

org_units.description: Org-unit surface (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: total, max_depth, and the per-OU inventory with user_count and the block_inheritance policy-override flag.

endpoint.description: Managed-device surface (mobile + Chrome OS; audit and above, omitted at trust). Audit: counts by OS, not_synced_30d, and per-OS compliant / non-compliant breakdowns. Internal: per-device rows (no serial numbers or IMEIs).

drive_external_sharing.description: Drive external-sharing audit. Audit: external-share and public-on-web event counts over 30 days. Internal: an event slice over 7 days with file_id, sharer_email, recipient_domain (domain only, never the full address), and target_role.

admin_audit_log.description: Security-relevant admin actions over 7 days. Audit: counts by category. Internal: the event slice (no debug-context payloads).

login_audit_log.description: Suspicious / failed logins over 7 days. Audit: counts. Internal: the event slice with IP for forensic correlation (no geolocation).

oauth_tokens.description: OAuth token audit over 7 days (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: issuance counts plus counts by app and by scope sensitivity. Internal: per-token grants with scopes (token values are never available via the API).

domain_settings.description: Domain + SSO (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: sso_configured flag, SAML-profile and verified-domain counts, plus per-profile and per-domain inventories. Internal: SSO service host (host only; never the full URL, signing certs, or metadata XML).

vault.description: Vault eDiscovery (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: licensed flag, matter / hold counts, and per-matter summaries. Internal: per-hold metadata (never the search query or hold contents). Absent license degrades to licensed=false.

permission_errors.description: Surfaces skipped because an OAuth scope or admin role is missing (a permission the customer can grant).

warnings.description: Informational warnings about data gaps or caveats (licensing, report lag, truncation).
